description: Baseline attempt — metric extraction bug: grep grabbed test file count (21) instead of test case count (233). Fixing autoresearch.sh.
Baseline: 233 passing compat tests, 21 files, 13 dirs covered. Fixed autoresearch.sh ANSI stripping.
Port app-fetch-deduping-errors: 3 tests for page rendering despite fetch errors in generateMetadata and page component
Skip app-invalid-revalidate: build-time validation test requiring file patching + server restart + CLI output checks. Not feasible with fetchHtml pattern.
Port forbidden: 5 tests for forbidden() boundary, 403 status, scoped + root escalation. Also triaged 6 P1 dirs as skip (Playwright/CLI/build-specific).
Port unauthorized: 5 tests for unauthorized() boundary, 401 status, scoped + root escalation. Skip proxy-missing-export (covered by PR #203).
Port catch-all-optional: 3 tests for optional catch-all routing. Batch-triage 14 more P1+P2 dirs as skip. 249 total tests.
Port simple-routes + FIX BUG: route handlers received plain Request instead of NextRequest (.nextUrl undefined). Wrapped in NextRequest in app-rsc-entry.ts.
Port rsc-redirect: 3 tests for redirect() from server component. Found RSC redirect behavioral difference (307 vs 200+stream). Triage 4 more dirs.
Port static-generation-status: 5 tests for notFound/redirect/permanentRedirect status codes + client component redirect SSR. Triage 5 more dirs.
Triage-only: batch-skipped 33 more P2/P3 dirs (parallel routes, interception, middleware, complex fixtures). 148/379 audited (39.1%).

Port layout-params: 6 tests. BUG FOUND+FIXED: layouts received ALL params instead of scoped per-segment params. Fixed 4 rendering loops in app-rsc-entry.ts + buildPageElement. Added cheerio + fetchDom helper.
Port metadata-dynamic-routes: 10 tests for robots.txt, sitemap.xml (alternates/images/videos), manifest.webmanifest, icon.tsx file convention routes.
Port searchparams-static-bailout: 5 tests for searchParams in server/client components, passthrough from server→client, and no-use pages. Triage 2 more dirs.
Port use-params (3 tests: useParams SSR for single/nested/catchall) + conflicting-search-and-route-params (2 tests: same-name route vs search param). Triage 3 more dirs.

Port _allow-underscored-root-directory: 3 tests using dedicated fixture. Added APP_UNDERSCORED_ROOT_FIXTURE_DIR and a minimal fixture to verify private underscore folders are hidden while %5F-decoded folders remain routable.

Port use-cache-route-handler-only: 2 tests using a dedicated route-handler-only fixture. Verified function-level "use cache" in route handlers and revalidatePath() invalidation without any pages present.

Port dynamic-data: 4 dev-mode HTTP tests for top-level, force-dynamic, force-static, and client-page request API usage. BUG FOUND+FIXED: force-static pages leaked real searchParams instead of empty object.
